import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Map 'yes'/'no' alive values to numerical values
df['alive'] = df['alive'].map({'yes': 1, 'no': 0})

# Plot survival rate by sex
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='sex', hue='alive', data=df)
plt.title('Survival Rate by Sex')

plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Alive')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.clf()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.clf()

plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='class', hue='alive', data=df)
plt.title('Survival Rate by Class')
plt.xlabel('Class')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Alive')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, append_args={'mode': 'a'})
plt.clf()

# Plot survival rate by age group
bins = [0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80]
